notes.title: Patch 2.2 notes
notes.content:
Glory to the horseshoe!

Bugfixes
 We fixed the player involuntarily sliding off of a checkpoint in level 8
 Tractors and buses now have better GPS
 Cops shall no longer be struck imperfectly by horseshoe damage
 The rooster's force field now more accurately absorbs bombs
 Level 8 damage to player has been untangled
 We corrected anomalous visual behavior when dying to spikes
 Owls now die as they should
 We tidied up building shadows
 Ropes will clip no more
 Animation freezing in the final level has been fixed
 Pizzas shall no longer be collectively killed by the horseshoe
 The crushed animation now properly displays
 Cutscene alignment has been enhanced
 Cars will no longer clip at the edge of a cliff
 Spikes now hurt as they should
 We fixed not being able to throw the horseshoe diagonally with the d-pad
 Glitch tossing horseshoes while hanging from a ledge has been banished
 We improved animations with the Construction Worker boss
 The horseshoe should now stop properly at all walls
 Subtitles have been rightly nudged
 The rooster repair cutscene now glows like the stars
 Exorcised a bug from the Rooster Cockadoodledoo achievement


What is this animal? And he began to neigh!
 The horse inside us all represents eternity

notes.title: Patch 2.1 notes
notes.content:
The Final Horse free expansion is available now!

Clop, clop!
 A secret cheat code is waiting to be found!
 The final boss now looks more beautiful than ever
 We simplified the process for configuring a controller

Bugfixes
 Game lag glitch has been bucked
 Languages now save and load as intended
 We adjusted the horseshoe weapon hitting pizzas too early
 Accessing the menu during a cutscene now works as it should
 We corrected some menu alignment and menu transition imperfections
 Defeat sequences for bosses 6 and 7 have been tidied
 We neatened up alignment for certain horseshoe recall animations
 Minor tractor display issues have been rectified

What is this animal? And he began to neigh!
 The horse inside us all represents eternity

notes.title: Patch 2.0 notes
notes.content:
This patch includes The Final Horse as a free content expansion!

THE FINAL HORSE
 You can now play with a horse head and a human body
 All levels have been visually enhanced with friendly animals and farming equipment
 All cutscenes have been mind-bendingly remixed with new recorded dialogue, sound effects, and trippy visual madness
 New horse-themed sound effects and animations adorn the game like confetti
 We have prepared a complex new psychedelic weapon
 A new delightfully evil multi-stage boss has been unleashed
 New optional miniboss battles have been tucked away in hidden locations
 Two new difficulty settings have been added
 Easy mode is an easier experience of the hard boss content from The Final Specimen with all of the new material also included
 Hard mode is the toughest challenge yet with brand new sinister twists added to all 8 bosses
 There are now multiple possible game endings
 We have cursed you with several chilling cinematic gameplay moments
 You can now experience true shock and horror when you lose a continue
 There is a slamming new equine title screen
 We have included a handful of new achievements

Sweet, delicious grass
Subtitles and interface support has been added for Italian, Arabic, Czech, Dutch, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, and Ukrainian
There is new mysterious treasure hiding somewhere always close

What's next?

We plan on adding in a cool cheat code and patching any bugs!
 There will be a second cheat code added eventually that will allow for all sorts of ridiculous fun

notes.title: Neigh! THE FINAL HORSE trots ever nearer! A free horse-sized expansion!
notes.content:
Greetings Horselings,

In early 2019, we will set loose a free expansion to The Final Specimen: Arrival hereby dubbed THE FINAL HORSE!

This will be a psychedelic remix of the original game. You will play as a person with a horse for a face on a very mysterious quest to solve the meaning of life.

Hay Is for Horse People!
New versions of every boss fight
A brand new boss with multiple stages
Cutscenes reworked by aliens from 10,000 years in the future
Cute farm animals roaming everywhere
Crippling madness
Two new tiers of difficulty
New weapons
Secrets made of gold
Robots

All of the primary content for the expansion is done. We just need to tighten up the saddle, and then we'll be ready to ride off into that neon green sunset to finally bring peace to all of the robots at once.

notes.title: Patch 1.4 notes
notes.content:
This patch includes the full soundtrack as free DLC and multilanguage support!

Updating the game based on community feedback is something that we believe is important. Every so often we will either make some changes or add in something completely new.

Alright!
Subtitles were added for English
Subtitles and interface were added for French, German, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, simplified Chinese, Spanish, and traditional Chinese
The soundtrack has been made available as free DLC


Bugfixes

Level 4's crusher will no longer push you into the ground if you stand at the edge of it
We fixed a bug where floating bomb pickup items fell to the ground
Swings in levels 3 and 7 will now always move at a consistent speed
A level 7 boss bug that would prevent the boss fight from ending has been removed
Falling into a slime pit and getting hit by an anvil at the same time no longer freezes the controls
An issue with the level 4 boss's charge has been resolved


What's next?

We will soon release a new playable character with some special surreal content as an enhancement to the whole game for free

notes.title: Patch 1.3 notes
notes.content:
Updating the game based on community feedback is something that we believe is important. Every so often we will either make some changes or add in something completely new.

Alright!

All bosses on hard mode have had their difficulty upgraded with new content
Continues have been increased on hard mode from 3 to 5
Several bosses now more gracefully jump and land
Obstacle hitboxes on the final boss have been made more accurate


Bugfixes

We fixed some enemies not counting towards punch and bomb counter achievements
Dropped bombs now correctly land without getting stuck
The rope at the beginning of level 6 will no longer cause problems with player movement
The boss music on level 4 will now cleanly loop
Bombs can no longer be thrown during cutscenes


What's next?

Subtitles for multiple languages will be added over time
Neigh, neigh, neigh

notes.title: Patch 1.2 notes
notes.content:
Updating the game based on community feedback is something that we believe is important. Every so often we will either make some changes or add in something completely new.

Alright!

The boss fight of level 6 now has added depth and difficulty
Thomas will no longer be able to easily hide from the boss's attacks because the safe zone on the rope has been removed
The boss will wind up before each hit to indicate where he will strike
When the boss is vulnerable to damage, his eyes will blink twice to allow time to react


Audio

Volume levels have been tweaked across the entire game to create a more pleasant listening experience
Analog distortion has been eliminated by accounting for true peak clipping
Cutscenes are easier to hear
Loud sound effects now know their place


What's next?

At the end of June, hard mode will see all boss fights updated with brand new mechanics
Neigh

notes.title: Patch 1.1 notes
notes.content:
Updating the game based on community feedback is something that we believe is important. Every so often we will either make some changes or add in something completely new.

Alright!
Checkpoints now autosave progress
Menus allow for easier navigation
Level 3 has clearer mechanics
"Press enter to skip" has been removed from cutscenes
Any assigned key or button now skips a cutscene
The title screen no longer shows a version number


Bugfixes

We eliminated periodic screen tearing
Customized Keys now apply only to gameplay, not menu screens
Dropped bombs no longer get stuck in a chimney
